decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates sit close to the firm's core glass processing offer and its announced push into higher-value packaging, have been on the website for two consecutive years, and fit a growing glass-substrate market, so investment and strategic fit argue strongly for keeping them.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring was recently launched with a dedicated web page, reflects the firm's stated investment in newer processing technologies, and any slow early uptake can reasonably be attributed to the normal ramp-up of a new technology, so management will persist with it.
